title: Add backend orphan manifest proposal evidence
summary: Adds the backend-owned positive path for Pending Publish orphan-payload reconciliation: a dry-run can now produce a candidate only when the selected backend row already carries a complete validated pending_push_manifest.v1 proposal, and confirmed apply creates only the missing payload-adjacent manifest.
reason: The orphan-payload route existed but always blocked, even if future backend evidence supplied a complete manifest proposal. The apply route needed a constrained manifest-only path that keeps source/destination inference out of the WebView and request body while preserving the ordinary-orphan block.
behavior_before: Pending orphan-payload dry-runs always returned blocked rows and confirmed apply always rejected, even when a backend row could carry complete pending manifest evidence.
behavior_after: Pending orphan-payload dry-runs still block ordinary orphan rows, but rows with complete backend_manifest_proposal/orphan_manifest_proposal/proposed_manifest evidence become manifest-write candidates. Confirmed apply reruns the dry-run, requires strict confirm_apply plus matching fingerprint, validates the proposal again, and writes only the missing payload-adjacent .manifest.json.
rollback_plan: Revert the orphan manifest proposal candidate/apply helpers in src/mediapipeline/core/repair_reconcile/dry_run.py and apply.py, remove the positive orphan proposal tests, restore docs/inventories to the prior always-blocked orphan apply wording, and refresh generated summaries.

High-risk boundary: this change creates a manifest only from backend dry-run proposal evidence. It never accepts paths or manifest fields from the WebView/apply request, never moves/deletes/drains/publishes payloads, and does not touch source/output/payload bytes. Representative source/payload/output hash validation and deferred publish/drain real-media validation were not run in this slice and remain required before daily-driver use.
